query:
SELECT p.workflow, count(*) AS "held!" FROM pending p
               WHERE p.almanac = $1 AND p.workflow = ANY($2)
                 AND NOT EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM runs r
                   WHERE r.almanac = p.almanac AND r.workflow = p.workflow
                     AND r.key = p.key AND r.status = 'running'
                 )
               GROUP BY p.workflow
